0022600161.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 5th in the Atlantic, 15th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (2-4, 4th in the Atlantic, 11th in the East) in the Nets' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Brooklyn 1-2 on the road and New York 1-2 at home. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise), Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain), and Mikel Brown Jr. (day-to-day, rest, game-time decision; 10.3 points and 22.6 minutes per game this season), while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nets were swept 0-4 by the Knicks in 2025-26, and their most recent meeting, on March 20, 2026 in Brooklyn, ended in a 93-92 Nets loss.
